name: ecTSase (thymidylate synthase from E. coli)
notes: Paper gives EC 2.1.1.45 (same in UniProt). Paper writes 'E. coli', no strain; P0A884 (strain K-12, 264 aa; identical sequence in most E. coli strains) is the reference of all RCSB ecTSase entries. Numbering matches P0A884 (Met1 = 1): Y209, C146, W80, L143, R127, R21, S210, I264 checked. Full-length 264-aa construct (expression per refs 41/70, not described further). RCSB searched by P0A884 (67 entities) and by sequence (>= 90 % identity, 68 entities): Y209W only in 4GEV (Y209W + dUMP + CB3717, 1.3 Å; primary citation DOI 10.1021/ja307859m = this paper; the paper's new refinement of 2G8M) and 2G8X (Y209W apoprotein, 1.83 Å; mutation field also lists 'N-terminus is carbamylated', a modification, no other sequence difference; primary citation Newby et al. without DOI). Paper names 2G8M (obsolete 2012-08-29, replaced by 4GEV) and 4GEV; WT comparison 2G8O (obsolete, replaced by 4IW5, later 4KNZ, now 6NNR).

name: ecTSase (Escherichia coli thymidylate synthase)
notes: Paper gives no EC; 2.1.1.45 from UniProt P0A884. No strain stated (expression per ref 76); P0A884 = strain K-12, 264 aa. Numbering matches P0A884 (Met1 = 1): E58, N76, T78, W80, E82, W83, I264, I29, G31, F36, F152, K158, Q165, D198 checked. Full-length protein; Mg2+ is a condition, not a variant. 37 full-length WT entries for P0A884 at RCSB, so pdb left empty. Entries the paper names: 2G8O ('originally 2G8O and now 4IW5'; 2G8O obsolete 2013-02-20, replaced by 4IW5), 4IW5 (obsolete 2013-05-22, replaced by 4KNZ, which was replaced by 6NNR on 2019-01-30), 4ISK (WT + dUMP + BGC 945 with Mg2+; primary citation 10.1021/jm400490e), 1TSN (FdUMP + CH2H4folate complex, used for the NMR map). 6NNR (current successor of 2G8O/4IW5, 'high-resolution structure of wild-type E. coli thymidylate synthase', 1.05 Å) has primary citation DOI 10.1021/ja400761x (this paper).
